operator: General Consulting Services Pty Ltd as trustee for the Australian Business Trust, trading as National Digital

classificationPolicy.cashCosts: All dedicated How2Vote hosting and domain cash costs are conservatively counted as electoral expenditure. This over-inclusive approach avoids needing to rely on a narrower historical, educational or non-election dominant-purpose classification.
classificationPolicy.unpaidLabour: Project labour by Cameron Young and Tara Buckley is recorded at $0 because National Digital incurred no additional salary, director fee, bonus, contractor fee, invoice or other project-specific liability. No commercial charge-out rate or opportunity cost is imputed.
classificationPolicy.sharedOverheads: Existing National Digital subscriptions and overheads are included only where a dedicated incremental How2Vote cost was incurred. Otherwise the project-specific amount is $0.
classificationPolicy.estimates: Historical AWS and registrar figures are operator-reconstructed approximate AUD amounts. Supporting invoices or billing exports should be retained where available, but exact reconciliation cannot affect the threshold outcome because the recorded totals are far below the applicable thresholds.

forecast.note: The domain renewal amounts supplied by the operator are treated as forecasts, not 2026-H2 expenditure, because the stated renewal dates fall in 2027 (the .au and .com.au renewals around May 2027; the how2vote.app renewal around July 2027). If an invoice shows any amount was actually incurred before 2027-01-01, move that item into 2026-H2.

disclosureEntity.determination: National Digital did not exceed the applicable electoral-expenditure disclosure threshold in any reviewed financial or transitional reporting period. No third-party or significant-third-party return is required for those periods on the recorded facts.
disclosureEntity.basis: Even after conservatively treating every dedicated How2Vote hosting and domain cash cost as electoral expenditure, the highest annual amount was A$578.30, compared with the applicable threshold of A$16,900. The 2026-H2 actual amount through 2026-07-26 was A$46.75, compared with A$17,300.
